message.content: Aisha Wahab, running for CA-14 United States Representative, answered "Yes" at an April 7 candidate forum that Israel has committed genocide in Gaza and introduced a California Senate resolution describing the Israel-Hamas war as genocide. She cosponsored H.R. 3565, the Block the Bombs Act, and voted No on a measure to defund universities that boycott Israel. Independent spending supported her through J Street Action Fund ($104,048) and opposed her through UDP ($1,642,139) and BOLD America ($610,970). CAIR Action endorsed her; Vote for Peace rated her Ally; BAMC Action supported her. Contrary to this alignment, JStreetPAC endorsed her and Hindu's for Human Rights Action PAC endorsed her. She did not sponsor bills recognizing the Nakba, requesting humanitarian aid for Gaza, restoring UNRWA funding, or recognizing genocide of the Palestinian people, and she abstained on AB 715, a California antisemitism-coordinator bill.
